phases.title:
The answer was only
part of the work.
phases.description: Separate observations find their references. Comparison, sequence and context are reconstructed into one understandable task.

phases.title: Again.
phases.description: The completed task clears. Different evidence enters from another direction, but the same relationships have to be reconstructed.

phases.title:
Good reasoning should
outlive the task.
phases.description: Temporary evidence leaves while its relationships stay. The retained structure accepts new observations, gains repeatable states, and opens into the positions occupied by real ARTIFACTS interfaces.
